_comment: Memory probes with a declared category and declared negatives. The frozen retrieval fixture next to this one expresses only {query, expected[]}, so a negative had to be hardcoded in the test body and a restraint case could not be written at all. Every case here seeds its own corpus, because UPDATE needs a chunk that was retired and RESTRAINT needs a corpus that provably lacks the subject. `filler` pads the corpus so term rarity is meaningful: a term counts as distinctive at df <= 10% of documents, so a seed of three cannot produce one. Deterministic gate only; no model is invoked. Seeds live under specs/probe/ and probe chunks under MEM-2026010*, both cleared between cases: without that, a later case retrieves an earlier case's corpus and the gate stops measuring what it names.
